cluster_detection.notes: Voice carries the house register: honest hedges stated as prose ('treat 2024 as freshened, not transformed'), price conflicts surfaced rather than averaged, one deliberate pastoral beat (Queen's Staircase), short-cruise counsel written from reasoning rather than template ('a four-night cruise is not a compressed seven-night cruise').
